demonstrate knowledge of the English language through the presentation of one of the recognized certifications for the purpose of certifying knowledge of the English language of at least equal to B1, relating to the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR);

note.fr: Admission sur concours : test CISIA CEnT-S obligatoire (seules les sections Mathematics et Reasoning comptent, min. 11 points au total dont 6 en Mathematics). Sans certification d'anglais B1, un entretien en anglais est proposé.
note.en: Competitive admission: mandatory CISIA CEnT-S test (only the Mathematics and Reasoning sections count, min. 11 points total with 6 in Mathematics). Without a B1 English certificate, an online English interview is offered.

evidence.quote: have obtained a minimum overall score of 11 points overall by adding the scores of the "Mathematics" and "Reasoning on texts and data" sections

notes: Tuition left out: the pages give only an income-based system (ISEE bands, MAC1/MAC2 with 13 bands, or a fixed amount of € 202.00/€ 500.00 for foreign students without ISEE). No quote for the 2026/27 academic year applies one single tuition figure or one lowest+highest fee to this non-EU applicant with a household abroad, and no quote names Morocco for a country-group reduced fee, so no tuition could be stated. The '€ 202.00 for foreign students who belong to developing countries' / '€ 500.00 for foreign students who do not belong to developing countries' contribution is a fee for foreign students without ISEE, but the pages do not tie Morocco to the developing-countries group, so it was not used. Intakes: two rounds exist for non-EU candidates residing abroad in AY 2026/27 (first round deadline 03 July 2026; the re-emission round of 30/09/2026 gives a deadline of 21 September 2026 for 88 remaining places); the first round is reported here.
